adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `feed_key` is defined but never referenced anywhere in the diff. The `poll_feed` method always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates `rss.items.each`, with no conditional GET / modified-since/etag gating, so each scheduled run re-parses the full feed and attempts to import every item. Additionally, `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` when `feed_polling_enabled?`, which can trigger the same full-feed parse during embed retrieval. This is a real, diff-grounded maintainability/performance concern and dead-code issue, but not a clear correctness defect because `TopicEmbed.import` de-duplicates by `embed_url` and only updates when `content_sha1` changes.
